phase: Phase 3: File playback in the AudioBus
summary: The Phase 3 code and tests pass the requested five-file suite, but an old in-flight decode can repopulate a changed event and play the wrong file. The checkout HEAD also differs from the requested audited head.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Major] review-a: src/apk3d/audio/bus.ts:125-136, 288-299 clears the changed event's buffer and loading marker but does not invalidate the outstanding fetch/decode. decodeData stores the result whenever the current event has any mapping, without checking that the mapping or base still matches the request. If correct maps to right, its fetch starts, then correct maps to wrong before the decode resolves, the old right buffer is stored and play('correct') plays right under the new map. The adversarial test `keeps the in-flight fetch URL when the map is swapped mid-flight` currently accepts this stale buffer. Preserve per-event retry behavior, but bind each async load to the mapping/version that started it and reject stale completion.
